range-slider.$description: v0.7 — Single + dual-handle range slider. Two overlaid <input type='range'> for dual mode. The track is sunken; the active range fills with the spring-green accent; thumbs are pure-white circles with a hairline border for grip affordance. v0.11.13 — thumb.background now references {color.absolute.white} (was inlined #ffffff).

track.$description: The full-width 1 px-tall sunken bar behind the active range.

range.$description: The lime fill between the two handles (or between min and the single handle).

thumb.$description: The drag handle. White circle with hairline border. Cursor changes to grab/grabbing on press.

size.$description: 16 px — meets minimum touch target with hover-area extension.

ring-focus.$description: Lime focus ring around the thumb when keyboard-focused.

value.$description: The numeric value labels rendered beneath the track (left + right).

height.$description: Vertical slot the track + thumbs share. Needs to be at least the thumb diameter so the thumb doesn't clip.
